evidence.claim: TAL-74 has a description and three acceptance criteria: full or partial credit, credit note linked to the invoice, invoice balance updated.
The decision page Decision: sent invoices are immutable says mistakes on sent invoices are corrected by issuing a credit note, which matches this issue.
TAL-69 only exports invoices and credit notes as CSV. It is related but does not cover issuing credit notes, so it is not a duplicate.

body.why: TAL-74 has a description and clear acceptance criteria, and nothing linked blocks it. The decision page Decision: sent invoices are immutable agrees with it, because it says mistakes on sent invoices are fixed by issuing a credit note.
wouldChange: A linked issue that must ship first, such as an unresolved credit note data model, would make this Blocked.
An earlier issue that already covers issuing credit notes from sent invoices would make this a Duplicate.
